solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Nimble and flexible model turned 51 earlier

indicators.note: earlier says the Roman numeral comes before the turned model in the answer

parts.note: LI is 51 in Roman numerals

indicators.note: turned means the model's name is read backwards

parts.note: Kate Moss, the fashion model

explanation.surface: A supple fashion model has turned fifty-one, though her birthday came earlier than expected.
explanation.definitionFit: Lissom describes a body that is lithe and supple, both nimble and bendy.

clue.text: Novelist initially into Buddhism

parts.note: the novelist D. H. ... has initials D and H, and those two letters sit side by side inside the word BudDHism

explanation.surface: A writer who first took up Buddhism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Initially' reads as 'at first', but it means 'by his initials': D.H. appears inside the word Buddhism.
explanation.definitionFit: D. H. Lawrence, author of Sons and Lovers, is the English novelist whose initials are D.H.

clue.text: Tiger seen here mistakenly, it's plain

indicators.note: mistakenly says the letters of tiger seen are in the wrong order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone thought they spotted a tiger there, but they were wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'here' is a link word pointing to the plain itself; there are no wild tigers on the Serengeti, which makes the sighting a mistake in the surface too.
explanation.definitionFit: The Serengeti is a vast grassland plain in Tanzania, famous for its wildlife.

clue.text: More than one painting topless works

indicators.note: topless means the first letter of the word for works is removed

parts.note: toils means works hard, labours

explanation.surface: Several paintings in a gallery show topless figures.
explanation.definitionFit: Oils are paintings done in oil paint, so the plural means more than one such picture.

clue.text: Need time

definitions.meaning: as in 'there is no need to worry', a reason or call for something
a particular moment or event, as in 'on that day'

explanation.surface: A demand for more hours.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a cause or reason (no need) and a particular moment when something happens.

clue.text: Residence of Prince Charles once EU gets involved

indicators.note: gets involved suggests the letters are tangled up together and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Prince Charles's home was once caught up in European Union affairs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Charles' is part of the fodder, not the definition; the surface reads 'Prince Charles' as one name but the definition is just 'Residence of Prince'.
explanation.definitionFit: Clarence House in London was the official residence of the Prince of Wales, Charles, before he became king.

clue.text: Further operation required by gangster

indicators.note: required by places the gangster's name after the operation, as what the operation needs

parts.note: addition is an arithmetic operation
Al Capone, the notorious Chicago gangster

explanation.surface: A gangster needs another operation, perhaps on a wound.
explanation.definitionFit: Additional and further both mean extra, more than already exists.

clue.text: Setter is into both men and women's feet

parts.note: the setter refers to himself as I, so 'setter is' becomes I AM
bisexual, shortened to bi, means attracted to both sexes; 'into' means keen on

explanation.surface: The crossword setter is fascinated by the feet of both sexes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'feet' is metrical: poetic feet, not body parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Iambi are metrical feet of one short and one long syllable, used in verse.

clue.text: Playing partners holding stake in French port

indicators.note: holding means the bridge partners surround the stake

parts.note: in bridge, North and South are partners at the card table
an ante is a stake put up before a hand in poker

explanation.surface: Card players hold a stake while gambling in a French city.
explanation.definitionFit: Nantes is a city and port on the Loire in western France.

clue.text: Violinist with animated cat likes playing outside right in front of royalty

indicators.note: in front of places the jumbled part before the royal abbreviation

parts.note: Fritz the Cat is a cartoon cat from an animated film

indicators.note: outside means the rearranged letters go around the abbreviation for right
playing suggests the letters of likes are moving about and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged
ER, Elizabeth Regina, the royal cipher

explanation.surface: A violinist plays with a cartoon cat in front of the royal family.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playing' turns LIKES into KEISL, which goes 'outside' R to make KREISL.
explanation.definitionFit: Fritz Kreisler was a famous Austrian-born virtuoso of the violin and composer.

clue.text: During quarrel bra worries backing singer

indicators.note: backing means the letters are read in reverse order
during means the letters are found inside the run of words quarrel bra worries

explanation.surface: Mid-argument, worries about a bra support a backing vocalist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing singer' looks like one phrase, but 'backing' is the reversal signal and 'singer' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A warbler is a songbird, and also a person who sings, so either way a singer.

clue.text: Agreed about odd bod's belly

indicators.note: about means the word for agreed goes around the other letters

parts.note: amen is said to express agreement, 'so be it'

indicators.note: odd suggests the letters of bod are strange, out of order and rearranged

explanation.surface: Everyone agreed about some strange fellow's paunch.
explanation.definitionFit: The abdomen is the stomach area of the body, the belly or tummy.

clue.text: Bird from another nest

indicators.note: from means the letters are taken out of the words another nest

explanation.surface: A bird has come from a neighbouring nest.
explanation.definitionFit: The erne is the white-tailed sea eagle, a large bird.

clue.text: Wily setter, cooking with sage

indicators.note: cooking means the letters of setter are being worked over and rearranged

parts.note: sage as a noun is a wise person, as an adjective it means wise

explanation.surface: A cunning crossword setter is cooking with sage the herb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sage' reads as the herb in the kitchen picture, but it means wise.
explanation.definitionFit: Streetwise means shrewd in the ways of urban life, savvy and cunning, so wily.

clue.text: Non-drinking male — in his pocket was just what was needed

indicators.note: in means the abstainer and male go inside the other pieces

parts.note: taken as written
TT, teetotal, means not drinking alcohol
he is the male pronoun
a pot is a pocketed ball in snooker; to pot is to pocket

explanation.surface: A teetotal man has just what he needs in his pocket.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to satisfy exactly, to be precisely what was wanted.

clue.text: Put some money in the bank as a way of paying later

definitions.text: Put some money in the bank
definitions.meaning: to add funds to the balance of one's bank holding
an arrangement with a shop to buy now and settle the bill afterwards

explanation.surface: Saving money in the bank as a means to pay for things later.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb phrase it means depositing funds; as a noun it is a store arrangement for deferred payment.

clue.text: See 15
Putting in order in French — gin drunk without tonic initially?

indicators.note: initially means the unmixed piece comes first in the answer

parts.note: a spirit drunk without a mixer is drunk neat
en is French for in

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters of gin are reeling and rearranged

explanation.surface: Tidying up in France, someone wonders if gin is drunk without tonic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' looks as if it goes with 'without tonic', but it is the anagram signal for gin.
explanation.definitionFit: Neatening means tidying, arranging things in an orderly way.

clue.text: See 9
Bit of a sweet gum 'ere, perhaps?

definitions.text: Bit of a sweet gum 'ere, perhaps?

parts.words: Bit of a sweet gum 'ere, perhaps?
parts.note: the letters of gum ere jumbled with IN inside, as if to say gum in 'ere, a cockney 'in here'

explanation.surface: A cockney points to a piece of sticky dessert: gum in here.
explanation.walkthrough: The dropped H of ''ere' suggests a cockney speaker; the answer is GUM ERE scrambled with IN in the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: A meringue is a light baked confection of egg white and sugar, often part of a pudding.

clue.text: See friend at one cinema

parts.note: to picture something is to see it in the mind
a pal is a friend
an ace is a one in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: Meet a friend at a particular cinema.
explanation.definitionFit: A picture palace is an old-fashioned name for a cinema, a grand movie house.

clue.text: See 20
Spouse unfortunately works

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests the letters of spouse have gone wrong and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Sadly, someone's husband or wife has to go to work.
explanation.definitionFit: Opuses are musical or literary compositions, a composer's works.

clue.text: See 5
Hack reporting about love for parent?

indicators.note: about means the jumbled letters surround the zero
hack means chop up, so the letters of reporting are cut about and rearranged

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A journalist reports on love for a parent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hack' looks like the journalist, but it is the anagram signal; the question mark flags that an ancestor is a broader kind of parent.
explanation.definitionFit: A progenitor is an ancestor or forefather, a parent in the broad sense of an originator of a line.

clue.text: Norwegian group after short time over in US city

indicators.note: after places the band's name after the reversed time
over means the word for a short time is turned round

parts.note: mo is short for moment, a short time
A-ha are a Norwegian pop group, famous for Take On Me

explanation.surface: A Norwegian band, after a short break, is over in an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: Omaha is the largest city in Nebraska, in the United States.

clue.text: Fairy appearing in first half of Shakespeare play

indicators.note: first half of means only the opening four of the play title's eight letters are kept

parts.note: Pericles, Prince of Tyre, is a play by Shakespeare

explanation.surface: A fairy appears in the opening part of a Shakespeare play, like A Midsummer Night's Dream.
explanation.definitionFit: A peri is a fairy or sprite in Persian mythology.

clue.text: Girl adopted by Maggie Thatcher initially

definitions.meaning: Margaret Thatcher's slogan 'There Is No Alternative' was known by its initial letters

explanation.surface: A girl was taken in by Margaret Thatcher at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adopted' sounds like taking in a child, but it means taking up a slogan; 'initially' says it is an acronym.
explanation.definitionFit: Tina is a woman's name and also the acronym of Thatcher's catchphrase about economic policy.

clue.text: Knife left in incorrect places

indicators.note: in means the abbreviation goes inside the jumbled letters
incorrect says the letters of places are wrongly ordered and need rearranging

explanation.surface: A knife has been left lying in the wrong places.
explanation.definitionFit: A scalpel is a small, very sharp surgeon's knife.

clue.text: Voyage in trouble east of Sweden

indicators.note: in an across answer, east of means to the right of, so the struggling piece comes after

parts.note: S is the international vehicle code for Sweden
ailing means sick or struggling

explanation.surface: A sea journey runs into trouble off the coast of Sweden.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailing is a trip by ship, a voyage across water.

clue.text: For which chaps have got into cooking ham and pea soups?

definitions.text: For which chaps have got into cooking ham and pea soups?

parts.words: For which chaps have got into cooking ham and pea soups?
parts.note: the opening letters of cooking ham and pea soups spell chaps, and the soups themselves are first courses of a meal

explanation.surface: A recipe question about men who have taken up making ham and pea soup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chaps' is not men: it is spelt by the first letters of 'cooking ham and pea soups', and soups are served first.
explanation.definitionFit: Starters are the opening dishes of a meal, and also initial letters of words.

clue.text: Hearing battle-axe will barter

indicators.note: hearing signals the words are taken by their sound when spoken

parts.note: a battle-axe is a fierce old woman, a hag, so this is hag'll

explanation.surface: A fearsome woman hears she will have to bargain.
explanation.definitionFit: To haggle is to bargain over a price, which is what bartering involves.
